title: ACR MCP investigation_result Request v1
description: Input for the investigation_result tool. Exactly one field, result_id, is accepted and required.

result_id.description: The result_id of a previous investigate_question answer, exactly as returned. Opaque: do not build or parse it. Access is re-checked against your credential on every call, so an id from another organization or one you are not allowed to read is refused.
